author.heading: About Francis of Assisi
author.bio: Francis of Assisi founded the religious movement that became the Franciscan order. His surviving rules, letters and admonitions address life together, humility and service. English quotations from those writings depend on the particular translator; the medieval author did not write these English sentences.

context.heading: The setting behind the words
lead: Admonition 27 sets virtues alongside the vices they displace. The next clauses connect patience with humility and poverty with joy. Robinson’s English sentence is one rendering of Francis’s spiritual instruction, not an English original composed by the medieval author. Robinson translation, full text ↗
